what.heading: What is OnsLand?
what.description: OnsLand is an interactive visualization project that explores how land is used across European countries. Using data from Eurostat, it presents land use patterns through beautiful hexagon-based visualizations, making complex agricultural and environmental data accessible and engaging.

data.heading: Data Source
data.description: All land use data comes from Eurostat's Land Cover Statistics 2022, which provides comprehensive information about how land is utilized across European Union member states. The data includes categories such as agricultural land, forests, urban areas, water bodies, and more.

contribute.heading: How to Contribute
contribute.intro: OnsLand is an open-source project, and we welcome contributions! Here's how you can help:
contribute.bugsDesc: Found an issue? Report it on GitHub
contribute.featuresDesc: Have an idea for improvement? We'd love to hear it
contribute.translationsDesc: Help translate the interface to more languages
contribute.dataDesc: Help keep the visualizations current with latest Eurostat data
contribute.codeDesc: Submit pull requests to improve the codebase

author.heading: About the Author
author.description: OnsLand was created by Koen van Gilst as an exploration of European land use patterns and data visualization techniques. The project aims to make complex environmental data more accessible and engaging through interactive visualizations.
